is: Two public modules: the identity nouns (elements) and the seams that store and resolve them (ports).
conventions: A new port area adds a file under `ports/` rather than growing `mod.rs`.
Time is injected, never read from the ambient clock.

fs.name: elements.rs
fs.role: module index for elements/, live entities vs stubs

fs.name: ports.rs
fs.role: module index for ports/, re-exports the port traits flat

fs.name: ports/
fs.role: trait seams: account, user, profile, identity (DidMinter, DidOperations, KeyStore, PlcOperationLog), identity_resolver (IdentityResolver — handle↔DID lookups of actors Zurfur does not own), character, bug_report (BugReportStore: list_since; BugReportWrites: lock_reporter_and_count_since — the rate limit's count, reporter locked until the unit ends — and file), actor_identity, authenticator, public_records; errors.rs (HandleTaken, DidBelongsToAnotherActor, PublicRecordsError, AccountMismatch, BrowserMismatch, ResolveError)

notes: Adapters: `adapter-pg` implements the private-store ports, `adapter-atproto` the public ones (`PublicRecords`, the real `DidMinter`), `adapter-mem` fakes both.
`DidOperations` is interface-only — no adapter implements it, and whether `tombstone`/`update_handle` migrate off `DidMinter` is an open Engineer ruling.
